headline: Iran-Oman reach Hormuz shipping-route outline but Iran says it alone won't reopen waterway
gist: WTI $78.82 (+0.82% vs Fri close $78.18), above VWAP $78.81, upper half of day range $78.18-79.27. Iran and Oman agreed the geographic coordinates of a safe shipping corridor and a joint monitoring center for the Strait of Hormuz (joint statement in final drafting), but Iran said Saturday the deal alone won't be enough to free up the waterway. Oil had slid ~9% for the week through Friday ($81.92 Brent, $76.96 WTI) on deal-hope, then steadied/rebounded into Monday's open as the signing remains incomplete. Demand 78.58-78.70 defended repeatedly; supply 78.95-79.04 capped bounces. Source: Bloomberg/Reuters/CNBC.

headline: Titan Q1 FY27 PAT jumps 63% YoY to Rs1,777cr on jewellery strength, comfortably beats estimates
gist: Titan standalone-equivalent Q1 FY27 revenue +29% YoY to Rs21,356cr, net profit +63% YoY to Rs1,777cr, EBITDA margin improved to 13.53%; jewellery division +29.73% YoY led growth, watches and eyecare also posted strong double-digit growth. Comfortably beat brokerage PAT estimates of Rs1,360-1,390cr. Results announced Friday evening (Aug 7) after market close, first reflected in this brief following the weekend. Stock had hit a record intraday high of Rs5,007.55 on Aug 6 ahead of results. Source: Business Standard/NiftyTrader.

headline: Wall St hits fresh record Friday on soft jobs data; Asia extends gains Monday on Fed-cut bets
gist: Wall St Friday (Aug 7) close: S&P500 +0.6% to a fresh record 7,757.64 (topping Tuesday's ATH), Dow +0.3% to 54,036.93, Nasdaq +1.3% to 26,690.62 -- soft July NFP (-23K) reinforced Fed Sept rate-cut bets. Asia extended the move Monday: Nikkei +1.1% to ~66,330, Kospi +1.7% to ~6,367 (SK Hynix +3.1%, Samsung +2.6%). GIFT Nifty signaled a modestly positive/tepid open (~24,655-24,677, +10-35pts) amid lingering Hormuz-deal uncertainty capping enthusiasm. At 09:23 IST: Nifty 24,611.60 (+0.17%), near session highs 24,559.60-24,620.55; Sensex feed lagging at open (last confirmed Fri close 78,499.17, -0.58%), live reports pegging it ~100pts higher (~78,600); Bank Nifty 57,904.15 (+0.27%), mid opening range 57,810.60-58,012.60. Source: Business Standard/CNBC/Washington Post.

headline: FIIs turn net buyers Rs480cr, DIIs add Rs236cr in Friday's cash market
gist: Aug 7 (Friday) cash market: FII net buy Rs480.24cr (reversing Thursday's near-flat/marginal selling), DII net buy Rs235.56cr -- both institutional categories net buyers, broad-based support heading into the weekend. Source: NSE/Trendlyne.

headline: Gold, Silver hold near weekend records after gold's best week since January (+7%); Monday open eases
gist: Gold $4,385.70 (-0.32% vs Fri close $4,399.70), below VWAP $4,388.00, lower half of day range $4,373.90-4,408.00 -- easing off Friday's all-time record $4,432.30 (NFP-driven) as the weekend consolidation continues; still up ~7% for the week, best since January, and holding a seven-week-high plateau per Saturday/Sunday domestic prints. Silver $63.80 (+0.47% vs Fri close $63.499), above VWAP $63.65, upper half of range $63.20-64.24 -- up ~6.6% for the week after Friday's record spike to $65.48. Both driven by the Jul NFP shock (-23K vs +83K est) and Fed Sept rate-cut odds near ~90%. Supply 4,398-4,403 capping gold's bounce attempts; demand 4,378-4,381 defended twice. Source: Reuters/CNBC/StartupTalky.
